from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,traceback
R=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3];B=R/'build/literature-review/nfcore-runtime';O=B/'malt-index-native-prerequisites-1';assert not O.exists();O.mkdir();state=dict(status='FAIL2_NATIVE_INDEX_PREREQUISITES',whole_goal_complete=False)
def save(p,v):p.write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n')
try:
 command=[sys.executable,str(R/'tools/literature/build_malt_index_taxonomy.py'),'--java-bin',str(O/'no-installed-jdk'),'--out',str(O/'missing-jdk')];r=subprocess.run(command,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,timeout=30);(O/'missing-jdk.stdout').write_bytes(r.stdout);(O/'missing-jdk.stderr').write_bytes(r.stderr);save(O/'missing-jdk.process.json',dict(command=command,exit_code=r.returncode));assert r.returncode==3 and b'SKIP3' in r.stdout and b'Required action:' in r.stdout and b'skip this dependent' in r.stdout
 failure=json.loads((O/'missing-jdk/FAILURE.json').read_bytes());assert failure['dependent_analysis_skipped'] and (O/'missing-jdk/WARNINGS_FAILURE.md').is_file() and not list((O/'missing-jdk').glob('*.jar'))
 existing=O/'existing';existing.mkdir();keep=existing/'retained.txt';keep.write_bytes(b'original result\n');command[-1]=str(existing);r=subprocess.run(command,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,capture_output=True,timeout=30);(O/'existing.stdout').write_bytes(r.stdout);(O/'existing.stderr').write_bytes(r.stderr);save(O/'existing.process.json',dict(command=command,exit_code=r.returncode));assert r.returncode==3 and keep.read_bytes()==b'original result\n' and [p.name for p in existing.iterdir()]==['retained.txt']
 state.update(status='PASS_NATIVE_INDEX_MISSING_JDK_SKIP3_AND_EXISTING_OUTPUT_PRESERVATION',missing_jdk_skip3=True,explicit_user_recovery=True,existing_output_untouched=True,no_dependent_analysis_executed=True)
except Exception as e:state.update(cause=repr(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
save(O/'COMPLETED.json',state);print(state['status'],state.get('cause',''),flush=True);raise SystemExit(0 if state['status'].startswith('PASS_') else 2)
